stance_summary: Verified fact: the Fed delivered a 25bp hike to 3.75–4.00%, official SOFR jumped to 3.85 on 2026-09-17, US 2Y is 4.76 with a +57bp 1m and +9bp 1d extension, and SR3 still prices a rising 2027 path (SR3H7 4.58, SR3U7 4.755). Inference: price, policy and US macro gauges are aligned, so the hiking/higher-yield trend persists longer than ‘hike-was-priced’ and housing-pain fades assume. Unknown: the next US inflation/labor print and whether a 2023-02-style accident appears. Cleanest continuation is pay/short SOFR_2027-03, not fading USDCAD or AU housing.

expression_comparison.rates_candidate: Pay/short CME SR3H7 alias SOFR_2027-03 (frozen implied 4.58, +73bp vs overnight SOFR 3.85); outright short duration in implied-rate space, not a fly.
expression_comparison.rationale: The mechanism is persistence of the delivered US hiking cycle, which maps directly onto the SOFR/SR3 policy path. USDCAD is a real but mixed USD-up/CAD-down trend that also embeds Canada’s soft labor (gauge 38) and energy pass-through, so it is the inferior single-factor expression. Rates are preferred when the two are comparably clean; SR3H7 is markable from tradable_rate_curves after inspecting policy_paths.

context_build.causal_mechanism: Hot US inflation, labor and activity keep the Fed in a tightening cycle after the September 25bp hike. Higher overnight SOFR and a still-rising SR3 strip transmit that impulse into front-end yields. Housing-pain and ‘the hike was already priced’ are the transmission/fade narratives, not a reversal mechanism until inflation or labor actually breaks.
context_build.path_to_current_price: Cash SOFR spent May–mid-September mostly in a 3.50–3.68 band, then printed 3.85 on 2026-09-17 after the FOMC raised the funds range to 3.75–4.00%. Futures entered that decision with >90% odds of 25bp. US 2Y then extended to 4.76 (+8.999999999999986bp 1d, +56.99999999999994bp 1m, +125.0bp 1y). SR3 strip as of the frozen packet: SR3U6 4.0, SR3Z6 4.32, SR3H7 4.58, SR3M7 4.72, SR3U7 4.755 then a gentle decline. Parallel AU/CA front-end yields also rose over 1m (AU 2Y +39.1bp to 4.999; CA 2Y +31.0bp to 3.27) but the 1d impulse was US-up (AU 2Y −5.5bp that day).
context_build.known_vs_new_information: Known: August CPI had already kept a Fed tightening bias, and the 25bp hike was >90% priced into 16 September. New enough to trade now: the hike was delivered, SOFR gap-up to 3.85, US 2Y kept rising into 18 September rather than ‘selling the fact’, and the last-24h desk thesis plus BoJ 1.25% hike/BoE 6–3 split show the global easing impulse remaining constrained. AU housing (NSW stamp duty −24% y/y, volumes −18%, Sydney/Melbourne values >7% off peak) is known tightening-channel news, not a US reversal print.
context_build.market_implied_assumption: The SOFR path treats the cycle as largely a two-to-three-hike affair from 3.85 cash toward a 2027 peak near 4.755 (SR3U7) then slight easing (SR3H8 4.695). That assumes labor/inflation cool enough to cap terminal rates below 5% even though US 5Y is already 4.86 and US 10Y 5.01.
context_build.market_assumption_disagreed_with: The priced assumption that is wrong is that the delivered, well-telegraphed 25bp hike and 99th-percentile yield levels are a peak to fade. Trend persistence says the hiking/higher-yield regime continues and the SR3 2027 peak is too low, not that mean-reversion starts because the move is ‘done’ or because housing is hurting.
context_build.price_decomposition: Level: US 2Y 4.76 (1y pctile 99.8015873015873, 5y pctile 88.01587301587301); US 10Y 5.01 (1y/5y pctiles 99.60317460317461 / 99.92063492063492). Change: the 1m US 2Y rise (+57bp) is the strongest 1m G10 front-end move in the packet versus AU +39.1bp and CA +31bp. Policy component: overnight SOFR 3.85 versus SR3H7 4.58 is +73bp of additional tightening still in the 2027-03 window. Marginal driver of the latest print is the delivered FOMC hike plus still-hot US gauges, not a positioning squeeze (CFTC US2Y leveraged funds were already net short before the hike).

historical_reference.distribution: US 2Y 1y percentile 99.8015873015873 and z_1y 2.837131124906408; 5y percentile 88.01587301587301 and z_5y 0.8948625146528716. US 2s10s is 25.0bp, 1y percentile 0.1984126984126984, with a −21.0bp 1m flattening. SR3H7 implied 4.58 sits 73bp above cash SOFR 3.85. These percentiles are discovery context only, not the thesis.
analogs: US 2Y analog 2022-03-23: prior 1m +57bp at 2.13, then forward +59bp 1m and +88bp 3m (hiking-cycle continuation).
US 2Y analog 2022-09-16: prior 1m +57bp at 3.85, then forward +58bp 1m and +40bp 3m (continuation through the 2022 tightening).
US 2Y analog 2023-06-15: prior 1m +56bp at 4.62, then forward +12bp 1m and +40bp 3m (continued higher).
US 2Y analog 2023-02-16: prior 1m +56bp at 4.62, then forward −70bp 1m and −50bp 3m (the reversal analog; banking-stress regime).
historical_reference.regime_differences: The three continuation analogs were mid-hiking-cycle tapes with inflation still high, closer to today’s Fed-just-hiked, gauges-hot setup. The 2023-02 reversal coincided with a US regional-bank accident that is not in this packet. Current differences: SOFR/SR3 policy path is available and already prices ~90bp of further tightening to SR3U7 4.755; leveraged-fund shorts in UST 2Y are already 93rd percentile 1y; AU housing is deteriorating as the tightening channel, which is a possible later growth brake but is not a US labor/inflation break yet. No analog is a 1:1 replica.

independent_checks: Policy-path check: NY Fed SOFR 3.85 (2026-09-17) and CME SR3 strip SR3Z6 4.32 / SR3H7 4.58 / SR3U7 4.755, status ok, versus the delivered 3.75–4.00% funds range.

Macro-gauge check: US inflation 72, labor 75, activity 69, consumer 74 (all still hot; last_refresh_date 2026-09-17 overlay). Cross-market: CA CORRA 2.29 with a hiking strip to ~3.65 and AU AONIA 4.35 with +51bp to 4.86 by 2027-03; both confirm a global higher-rate trend rather than a US-only blip.
Price-trend check: US 2Y/5Y/10Y all at or above the 99th 1y percentile with positive 1d/1m/3m yield changes into 18 September, i.e. the hike was not sold.
context_build.flow_and_positioning_check: CFTC TFF as of 2026-09-15 (pre-hike): UST 2Y leveraged funds net −1,294,575 contracts (−29.19828785475725% of OI, 1y pctile 93.26923076923077, 3y pctile 97.75641025641026) while asset managers are net long +1,732,731. Specs already ride short-duration; that confirms the trend rather than explaining a one-off squeeze, but it is crowded. CME FX/rates LastTotals are unavailable (HTTP 403). Paper books are empty $100m seeds, so there is no legacy overlay. Flow does not replace the policy/macro mechanism.

policy_path_check.pricing_summary: US: SOFR 3.85; SR3Z6 4.32 (+47bp), SR3H7 4.58 (+73bp), SR3U7 4.755 (+90.5bp), SR1-style terminal 4.6025 at 2028-08. CA: CORRA 2.29; CRAZ26 2.775, CRAH27 3.13, strip peak ~3.65 by 2028-09 (+136.5bp). AU: AONIA 4.35; Oct-26 4.565 (+21.5bp), Nov-26 4.685, Mar-27 terminal 4.86 (+51bp). NZ policy path is not used (NZ_rates unavailable).
policy_path_check.rationale: Short-end US continuation must be anchored in the live SOFR/SR3 path, not a 2Y percentile. CA and AU paths are independent confirmation that G10 policy is still hiking, not pivoting; they are not the selected expression because US 1m front-end momentum and the delivered FOMC hike are the cleanest aligned trend.

trade.structure: Outright pay/short CME three-month SOFR March 2027 (code SR3H7, paper alias SOFR_2027-03) in implied-rate space; no curve fly, no bond/swap mix.
trade.thesis: FACT: FOMC hiked 25bp to 3.75–4.00%; SOFR 3.85; US 2Y 4.76 with +57bp 1m and +9bp 1d; SR3H7 implied 4.58; US gauges 69–75; August CPI kept the tightening bias; BoJ hiked to 1.25% and BoE held 6–3 with three hike votes. INFERENCE: when price, policy and revisions are this aligned, the higher-rate trend persists and the SR3 2027 peak near 4.755 is a premature fade, not a terminal. UNKNOWN: the next official US inflation/labor print and any non-linear credit accident (the 2023-02 analog). Ride continuation in SOFR, do not fade USDCAD or AU housing as if they were reversal signals.
trade.mispricing: The strip still treats the cycle as peaking near 4.755 then easing, which requires a cooling in US labor/inflation that the gauges and the post-hike 2Y extension have not shown. ‘Hike was >90% priced’ and Australian housing pain are being used as fade triggers without a US reversal print.
why_now: Delivered 25bp hike plus SOFR gap-up to 3.85 is confirmation of the trend, not a reason to fade it.
US 2Y kept rising after the decision (+9bp 1d into 2026-09-18) instead of selling the fact.
August CPI and all four US temperature gauges remain hot, so the catalyst has not expired.
Global tightening impulse (BoJ 1.25%, BoE three hike votes, CA/AU policy paths still hiking) reduces the odds of an isolated US pivot.
AU housing downturn and the 1d AU yield dip are the classic premature-fade tape; they do not invalidate the US path.

trade.entry: Frozen tradable_rate_curves CME SR3H7 / SOFR_2027-03 implied rate 4.58 (price 95.42); trusted code transacts at that packet mid.
trade.invalidation: A packet-supported US inflation or labor break that turns the SOFR strip lower, or a confirmed reversal in the US 2Y uptrend after the 2026-09-18 4.76 print without a new hawkish policy impulse. Housing-pain or ‘the hike was priced’ narratives alone are not invalidation.
catalysts: Next US inflation/labor prints that keep the Fed tightening bias intact.
Additional FOMC hikes that lift SR3H7/SR3U7 implied rates above the frozen 4.58/4.755 marks.
Global policy confirmation already in packet (BoJ 1.25%, BoE 6–3 hike votes, BoC energy pass-through, RBA path still hiking).
principal_risks: CFTC leveraged funds were already 93rd-percentile 1y short UST 2Y as of 2026-09-15; a squeeze can hurt a crowded short-duration book.
2023-02-16 analog reversed −70bp 1m after a similar +56bp prior 1m move in a banking-stress regime.
The 25bp hike was >90% priced, so residual surprise is smaller than a cold-start hiking cycle.
If the Fed pauses after one hike, SR3H7 4.58 already prices substantial further tightening.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: The delivered Fed hike, hot US gauges and rising SR3 path are an aligned continuation; fading it on ‘priced in’ or housing-pain grounds is premature.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Follow-through US inflation/labor prints and additional FOMC hikes that lift the 2027 SOFR strip.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: A US inflation or labor break that turns the SOFR strip and the US 2Y uptrend lower; housing-pain headlines alone do not count.

paper_actions.thesis: Pay/short SOFR_2027-03 as continuation of the delivered US hiking cycle; sidecar is flat so this is a new OPEN inside the $100m gross cap.
paper_actions.rationale: Empty trend-follower book; deploy half the $100m gross cap in the cleanest aligned rates continuation. Funding vig is paid on the full $100m either way.

rates_candidate.rationale: Pay/short SR3H7 implied 4.58 as the policy-path continuation of the Fed hike.

spot_candidate.rationale: Long USDCAD is the best spot alternative (USD-up/CAD-down) but mixes CA labor with the US policy impulse.

expression_memo.rationale: Rates are the cleaner expression of hiking-cycle persistence; USDCAD is inferior as a mixed CA/US factor.
